observations: body L2: a small speck is printed before «Circulus»; not transcribed.
body L5: a blot of ink is printed on the i of «Primus»; not transcribed.

figure: the labels are transcribed as printed: «Inpiter» (Gemini, terms), «Iupitor» (Cancer, terms), «Venns» (Pisces, terms) and «Verus» (Virgo, terms) are printed so; «Saturnus» (Taurus, faces) is printed with the t and the n broken; the exaltation of Capricornus is printed «♂ 28» without the sign of degrees.
figure: the signs of the planets are set in FreeSerif; the Moon of the print is a heavier crescent.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
